1.hint: 1. Examine the Existing PG16 Cluster - ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@[YOUR_SERVER_IP]

2.hint: 1. Examine the Existing PG16 Cluster - sudo -iu postgres

4.hint: 1. Examine the Existing PG16 Cluster - exit

5.hint: 2. Check Available Locales - locale -a | grep en_US

6.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - sudo su -

7.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - mkdir /opt/pgsql/data-test

8.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - chown postgres:postgres /opt/pgsql/data-test

9.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - chmod 700 /opt/pgsql/data-test

10.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - exit

11.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - sudo -iu postgres

13.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - ls /opt/pgsql/data-test/

14.hint: 3. Create a Fresh Test Cluster - exit

15.hint: 4. Compare pg_controldata Between Clusters - sudo -iu postgres

16.hint: 4. Compare pg_controldata Between Clusters - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_controldata /opt/pgsql/data | grep "system identi

17.hint: 4. Compare pg_controldata Between Clusters - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_controldata /opt/pgsql/data-test | grep "system i

20.hint: 4. Compare pg_controldata Between Clusters - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_controldata /opt/pgsql/data | grep "Bytes per WAL

21.hint: 4. Compare pg_controldata Between Clusters - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_controldata /opt/pgsql/data-test | grep "Bytes pe

23.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - sudo -iu postgres

24.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - vi /opt/pgsql/data-test/postgresql.conf

25.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - port = 5435

26.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_ctl start -D /opt/pgsql/data-test -l /opt/pgsql/l

27.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_isready -p 5435

28.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - psql -p 5435 -c "SELECT version();"

29.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_isready -p 5432

30.hint: 5. Configure and Start the Test Cluster - exit

31.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - sudo -iu postgres

32.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - /usr/pgsql-16/bin/pg_ctl stop -D /opt/pgsql/data-test

34.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - exit

35.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - sudo su -

36.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - rm -rf /opt/pgsql/data-test

37.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - ls /opt/pgsql/data-test

38.hint: 6. Tear Down the Test Cluster - exit
